milestones.claim: Only an eligible independent topology critic can authorize a current topology review.
milestones.doneMeans: The production verifier accepts the registered topology-critic role only when agent, session, dispatch, and business-author provenance are all distinct, and rejects spoofed, missing, collided, or replayed provenance.

milestones.claim: Topology critic approval is a signed current receipt bound to the complete authoritative proof context.
milestones.doneMeans: The production producer and verifier round-trip every required receipt field, reject all field/signature/freshness mutations, and deterministically bind canonical finding and exclusion references.

milestones.claim: Every topology exclusion requires separately attributable independent scope-plan approval and cannot override incomplete discovery.
milestones.doneMeans: The gate enforces exact one-to-one current approvals from lattice-review-scope-plan, rejects spoofed, orphaned, stale, duplicate, or conflicted approvals, and rejects partial or unsupported discovery despite a PASS critic receipt.

milestones.claim: Wave 2A authority is proven through the real producer-verifier-consumer chain without leaking later-wave behavior.
milestones.doneMeans: An isolated production-path transcript passes cleanly, every authoritative input and process-fact mutation bites and restores cleanly, no forged artifact remains reusable, and Wave 3/3A/4 capabilities remain absent.
